summary: Compiled 16 clinical-evidence rows (12 included, 4 considered_excluded SoC chemo) covering pan-RAS(ON) daraxonrasib (load-bearing NEJM 2026 PMID 42090791), ELI-002 amphiphile KRAS vaccine (AMPLIFY-201 Pant 2024 + Wainberg 2025), G12C cross-mutation context (sotorasib, adagrasib), POLO olaparib (gBRCA), Reiss rucaparib (BRCA/PALB2), avutometinib+defactinib (RAMP-201 LGSOC + RAMP-205 PDAC abstract), palbociclib NCI-MATCH Z1C, KEYNOTE-158 MSI-H pancreatic, CCTG PA.7 chemo+dual-ICI. SoC chemo (FOLFIRINOX, gem/nab, NAPOLI-1, NALIRIFOX) logged as considered_excluded for audit trail per Libby's feature-targeting scope rule.

Compiled 22 preclinical-evidence rows (19 included, 3 considered_excluded) covering: pan-RAS(ON) RMC-6236 / RMC-7977 (Holderfield Nature 2024 PMID 38589574; Wasko Nature 2024 PMID 38588697; Jiang Cancer Discov 2024 PMID 38593348); KRAS G12R distinctive biology (Hobbs Cancer Discov 2020 PMID 31649109; Singhi Cancer Res 2025); ELI-002 amphiphile vaccine preclinical (Rakhra JITC 2021 PMID 34376552); MEK + autophagy axis (Bryant Nat Med 2019 PMID 30833752; Kinsey Nat Med 2019 PMID 30833748); FAK + ICI (Jiang Nat Med 2016 PMID 27376576); MTAP / PRMT5 synthetic lethality (Mavrakis Science 2016 PMID 26912361; Kryukov Science 2016 PMID 26912360; Smith MRTX1719 Cancer Discov 2023 PMID 37552839); CDK4/6 axis (Franco/Witkiewicz Oncotarget 2014 PMID 25156567; Heilmann/Kapoor Cancer Res 2014 PMID 24986516; Knudsen Cancer Res 2023 PMID 36346366); APR-246 (Abrams Cells 2022 PMID 35269414); PARP synthetic lethality (Roberti J Med Chem 2020 PMID 31790586); CXCL12-CXCR4-FAP stromal axis (Feig PNAS 2013 PMID 24277834); NIS793 TGF-beta (Principe JCI Insight 2024 PMID 39288262). Excluded: MRTX1133 (G12D-selective, off-allele), AMG 510 (G12C-selective, off-allele), Olive 2009 hedgehog stroma vehicle (failed clinical translation).

Round 1 risktaker position written. 5 ranked picks by potential effect size: (1) daraxonrasib RMC-6236 NCT05379985/NCT06445062 — on-axis pan-RAS(ON) with NEJM 2026 ORR 35% / mPFS 8.5 / mOS 13.1 in 2L RAS G12 PDAC (PMID 42090791); (2) RMC-7977 + ivonescimab NCT07397338 — RAS(ON) + PD-1xVEGF bispecific for the MSS immune-cold barrier, anchored by KPC GEMM complete responses (Wasko PMID 38588697); (3) avutometinib+defactinib+gem/nab RAMP-205 NCT05669482 — 5/6 PR at dose level 1 (ORR 83%) plus LGSOC 44% ORR validation; (4) MTA-cooperative PRMT5i (anvumetostat NCT06360354 / navlimetostat NCT07492680) + daraxonrasib — gated on MTAP co-deletion reflex, double-hit on KRAS + 9p21; (5) palbociclib + MEK/ERK combination via ADOPT NCT06813079 or off-label — CDKN2A/CCND3 axis with Knudsen 2023 organoid synergy. Olaparib / eprenetapopt / ELI-002 7P excluded from ranking pending germline / TP53-class / line-eligibility resolution. No toxicity-veto conflicts.

Round 1 advocate position written. Preferences are unusually permissive (no toxicity vetoes, no modality constraints, efficacy_toxicity_weight 0.80, treat-to-remission, accepts high-risk-high-reward, prefers trials). 5 ranked picks all on the trial axis: (1) daraxonrasib monotherapy NCT05379985 — highest-evidence trial-route fit with NEJM 2026 ORR 35% / mPFS 8.5 / mOS 13.1 (PMID 42090791); (2) daraxonrasib + mFOLFIRINOX or gem/nab on NCT06445062 — deeper-response combination on oxaliplatin-naive backbone, RAMP-205 5/6 PR precedent; (3) RMC-7977 + ivonescimab NCT07397338 — highest-ceiling option, RAS(ON) + PD-1xVEGF for MSS immune-cold barrier; (4) PF-07934040 NCT06447662 — backup pan-KRAS trial naming G12R explicitly; (5) anvumetostat + daraxonrasib NCT06360354 — dual-feature targeting gated on MTAP co-deletion reflex. POLO olaparib excluded pending germline panel; ELI-002 7P excluded (overt-recurrent past MRD window); eprenetapopt excluded pending TP53 variant-class annotation; SoC chemo out of scope under targetable-feature rule. No toxicity-veto conflicts.

Synthesized 5 board positions + 20 cross-critiques into 11 ranked recommendations. All biomarkers confirmed -> scenario: null on every row (non-gated case). Rank 1: KRAS G12R orthogonal NGS + ctDNA confirmation (workup hardening, unanimous endorsement, agreement 1.0). Rank 2: daraxonrasib (RMC-6236) monotherapy on NCT05379985 -- all five personas put this at rank 1 (agreement 1.0); Wolpin NEJM 2026 PMID 42090791 (ORR 35%, mPFS 8.5, mOS 13.1 in 2L RAS G12 PDAC at 300 mg, n=26) is the load-bearing efficacy datum. Ranks 3-4: PF-07934040 NCT06447662 and PRMT5i + RAS axis NCT06360354 (agreement 0.6 each). Ranks 5-11: olaparib (gated on germline + platinum, considered_with_caveats per 2 dissents), daraxonrasib+chemo NCT06445062 (considered_with_caveats per 2 dissents), RMC-7977 + ivonescimab NCT07397338 (considered_with_caveats per 3 dissents), ELI-002 7P (considered_with_caveats per indication mismatch), RAMP-205 (considered_with_caveats per critic evidence-quality dissent), rucaparib, palbociclib (negative Z1C basket precedent). Cross-cutting caveat in index.md surfaces: (a) workup hardening per orthogonal NGS/ctDNA still required at screening despite confirmed local report; (b) germline panel decision-relevance (BRCA/PALB2/ATM/LFS) since not on file; (c) MSS + TMB 4.1 forecloses biomarker-agnostic ICI. G12C/G12D-selective agents excluded from ranking per sub-mutation-class scope rule.

Wrote plain_language.md (patient/caregiver track) translating the 11 PI recommendations into single-layout option ranking (no scenario branches; all biomarkers confirmed). Single unified voice, no board/persona/reviewer references. NCT IDs removed from body and parked in Sources footer. Absolute-risk framing replaces HRs throughout. KRAS G12R sub-mutation-class scope explained (G12C lung-cancer drugs do not apply). MSS + low-TMB explained as closing the standard ICI door, justifying why immunotherapy options are largely absent except the zoldonrasib + ivonescimab considered_with_caveats entry. Germline-panel decision-relevance surfaced both in the up-front workup section (as a parallel test to run alongside KRAS confirmation) and as a 'questions to ask your oncologist' item. MTAP testing surfaced as the gate for Option 3. PARP options (olaparib rank 5, rucaparib rank 9) framed with their two locked gates (germline result + platinum induction response). Disclaimer placed at bottom of file per contract. Humanizer pass applied to all prose sections.

notes: Non-gated case (all biomarkers confirmed); rank-1 NGS workup surfaced as sponsor re-test step rather than binary biomarker gate. target_validation_report covers 12 rows across KRAS G12R, TP53, CDKN2A, CCND3, MSS, TMB. mkdocs --strict clean; PHI scan clean.
